description: A Flutter widget representing the first screen of a ride-sharing app, requesting location and phone permissions, with UI elements including icons, text, and a button to proceed to the next screen.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the initial permission request screen for new users.

classes.name: _FirstScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for FirstScreen, including permission requests and navigation.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Builds a row widget with an icon and descriptive text for permissions.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Handles the permission request process and navigates to the second screen.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Requests location permission, updates preferences, and navigates to the next screen.
